Adrenocortical carcinomas are a rare but relevant tumor in Lynch Syndrome patients.

the identification of new tumour entities that are part of the Lynch syndrome spectrum.

the development of a novel and efficient strategy to detect Lynch syndrome (LS, a common hereditary colorectal cancer syndrome, in patients with adrenal cortical carcinoma (AC, an endocrine tumor with a high mortality rate.
